caption:
Most mountain trails in Costa Rica follow the fall line straight up the ridge. Without the gentle reprieve of switchbacks, mountain biking in Costa Rica becomes a direct negotiation between your lungs, the wet clay, and gravity. When the grade exceeds twenty percent, traction is a quiet, deliberate art—how you weight the rear tire, how smoothly you turn the pedals, and knowing when the most dignified choice is simply to walk. It is slow, demanding work, but it rewards you with a silence that cars will never reach.
